Northwind Coffee · Pay by Bank flow

The approved Straddle integration plan, from checkout to funding. A view of straddle-integration-plan.md; it changes nothing.

Direct integration, no Straddle-Account-Id Charges only @straddlecom/straddle 1.0.4 Webhook endpoint Sandbox

Checkout to charge

1

Checkout

Browser → app/api only
  • Name, email, E.164 phone, address
  • No key or paykey token reaches the browser
2

Customer

POST /api/customers
  • createCustomer
  • nw-cust-<orderId>
  • Draft order saved
3

Bank link

POST /api/bank-accounts
  • Only when customer is verified
  • createBankAccountPaykey
  • nw-pk-<orderId>
  • Stores paykey id, label, last4
4

Charge

POST /api/orders
  • Needs authorized and paykey active
  • Consent saved on the order
  • revealPaykey in memory, then createCharge
  • nw-order-<orderId>, internet, balance_check: enabled, Eastern date
5

Webhook events

POST /api/webhooks/straddle
  • Verify, store, then 204
  • Projects status onto the order
6

Funding

funding_event.event.v1
  • Lands on Order.funding
  • Sandbox: "Run Sandbox funding" calls simulateFundingEvent

Every create sends an idempotency key: a prefix plus a SHA-256 hash of its external ID (cus-, pk-, chg-). A retry reuses the key, so it returns the same charge.

How status arrives

Webhook handler

customer.*paykey.*charge.*funding_event.*
  1. Read the raw body. Verify with standardwebhooks (400 on failure, 500 if the secret is missing).
  2. Strip the paykey token, then append to data/webhook-events.jsonl by event_id. A duplicate changes nothing.
  3. Project onto data/orders.json by changed_at. An older event never replaces a newer one.
  4. Return 204. A failed write returns 500 so Straddle retries.

Pages

Order page reads the stored projection. "Refresh status" rereads the store and makes no Straddle request.

Back office shows each order, plus one review read and one paykey read per order on page load. Read-only: no review decisions, refunds, resubmits, or unblocks.

Sandbox defaults to customer verified, paykey active, charge paid. Test can override per request.

What the order does on each status

ResourceStatusShopper or back office sees
Customerreview"We're verifying your details." Bank linking waits.
Customerrejected"We can't take pay by bank for this order." No scores or codes.
Paykeyreview"We're verifying your bank account." Order creation waits.
Paykeyrejected blockedAsk for another bank account. A blocked (R29) account takes no new charges.
ChargepaidOrder paid, ready to ship.
ChargefailedReason and code shown; ask for another account. Insufficient funds says so.
Chargeon_hold"Under review", with no promised release.
ChargereversedBack office flags "returned after paid" with the code (for example R01), for manual recovery.
Funding eventcharge_deposit charge_reversalStatus on the order's funding step and in the back office.
